mapper.select: SELECT wd.doc_number AS docNumber, wd.doc_type AS docType, wd.business_category AS businessCategory, wd.project_id AS projectId, wd.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, wd.counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, wd.counterparty_name AS counterpartyName, wd.counterparty_address AS counterpartyAddress, wd.counterparty_contact AS counterpartyContact, wd.contract_number AS contractNumber, wd.doc_date AS docDate, wd.total_amount AS totalAmount, wd.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, wd.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, wd.remark, wd.create_time AS createTime, wd.create_user AS createUser, wd.update_time AS updateTime, wd.update_user AS updateUser FROM warehouse_doc wd LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON wd.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON wd.auditor_user = au.id ORDER BY wd.doc_date DESC, wd.doc_number DESC

SELECT wd.doc_number AS docNumber, wd.doc_type AS docType, wd.business_category AS businessCategory, wd.project_id AS projectId, wd.warehouse_id AS warehouseId, wd.counterparty_customer_id AS counterpartyCustomerId, wd.counterparty_name AS counterpartyName, wd.counterparty_address AS counterpartyAddress, wd.counterparty_contact AS counterpartyContact, wd.contract_number AS contractNumber, wd.doc_date AS docDate, wd.total_amount AS totalAmount, wd.entry_user AS entryUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(eu.real_name, ''), eu.username) AS entryUserName, wd.auditor_user AS auditorUser, COALESCE(NULLIF(au.real_name, ''), au.username) AS auditorUserName, wd.remark, wd.create_time AS createTime, wd.create_user AS createUser, wd.update_time AS updateTime, wd.update_user AS updateUser FROM warehouse_doc wd LEFT JOIN sys_user eu ON wd.entry_user = eu.id LEFT JOIN sys_user au ON wd.auditor_user = au.id WHERE wd.doc_number = #{docNumber}
SELECT MAX(CAST(RIGHT(doc_number, 3) AS UNSIGNED)) FROM warehouse_doc WHERE doc_number LIKE CONCAT(#{docNumberPrefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO warehouse_doc ( doc_number, doc_type, business_category, project_id, warehouse_id, counterparty_customer_id, counterparty_name, counterparty_address, counterparty_contact, contract_number, doc_date, total_amount, entry_user, auditor_user, remark, create_time, create_user ) VALUES ( #{docNumber}, #{docType}, #{businessCategory}, #{projectId}, #{warehouseId}, #{counterpartyCustomerId}, #{counterpartyName}, #{counterpartyAddress}, #{counterpartyContact}, #{contractNumber}, #{docDate}, #{totalAmount}, #{entryUser}, #{auditorUser}, #{remark}, NOW(), #{createUser} )
